title: Release
description: A Kimberley Process certificate is validated, or a grading report is issued - the same event, distinguished by standard (spec Sec.4). A claim, not a confirmation - whether the certifying party is legitimate is answered by its entity trust level (OWM-6), not by this schema. Two entries naming the identical reference for two different subjects is a structural contradiction (spec Sec.5).

standard.description: The basis for the certification, e.g. "kimberley-process", "gia-grading", "igi-grading".

reference.description: The KP certificate serial number, or the grading report number.
